name: 01-FirstHTML5Space-AIPP-AR-VR
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: 📋 Description: This is a fun 📚3D-VR simulator that shows a map 🗺️ with motion controls ⌨️ of the WASD keyboard. You can explore a 3D landscape 🏞️ using Aframe.

HTML: Hypertext Markup Language, a coding language used to create web pages. VR: Virtual Reality, an immersive experience that simulates a real environment. Aframe: A web framework used to create virtual reality experiences on the web. WASD: A set of four keyboard keys that are commonly used in video games for motion controls.
features: HTML5: Refers to the version of the HTML (Hypertext Markup Language) used to create the web page on which the 3D-VR-Aframe-Map is hosted.
3D: Refers to the three-dimensional nature of the map in the 3D-VR-Aframe-Map simulator.
VR: Refers to the virtual reality aspect of the 3D-VR-Aframe-Map simulator. Users can immerse themselves in the virtual environment and interact with it using VR headsets.
Aframe: Refers to the web framework used to create the 3D-VR-Aframe-Map simulator. Aframe is a popular framework for creating virtual reality experiences on the web.
Map: Refers to the representation of geographic or spatial data in a visual form. In the 3D-VR-Aframe-Map simulator, users can explore a 3D landscape using motion controls and a map interface.
